title: What It Actually Looks Like to Correct a Brother Without Crushing Him
caption:
A godly man can be dead honest and still not crush a man. Most guys think they have to pick one.

Say it to him, not about him in the group chat. Lead with what you actually respect before you land the hard thing. Correct the act, not the man. "You lied to her" isn't "you're a liar," and he can own one of those.

Then stay in the room after. That's the part that proves you did it for him.

#faith #brotherhood #accountability #godlyman #christianmen
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
